mapper.sql: commitment_id, operating_case_id, journey_id, commitment_type, content, owner, due_date, status, evidence_ref, created_at, fulfilled_at, interaction_id, customer_id, fulfilled_date, assigned_to, verified_by, recorded_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO commitment (commitment_id, operating_case_id, journey_id, commitment_type, content, owner, due_date, status, evidence_ref, created_at, fulfilled_at, interaction_id, customer_id, fulfilled_date, assigned_to, verified_by, recorded_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{commitmentId}, #{operatingCaseId}, #{journeyId}, #{commitmentType}, #{content}, #{owner}, #{dueDate}, #{status}, #{evidenceRef}, #{createdAt, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler}, #{fulfilledAt, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler}, #{interactionId}, #{customerId}, #{fulfilledDate}, #{assignedTo}, #{verifiedBy}, #{recordedAt, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler}, #{updatedAt, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM commitment WHERE status = 'OPEN' AND due_date < CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY due_date
SELECT FROM commitment ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE commitment SET status = #{status}, verified_by = #{verifiedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE commitment_id = #{commitmentId}
